# Stage A1 MP3 Fixture Permission

The 997 Hz waveform, metadata strings, generator code, and deterministic byte
mutations in this directory were created for OCRLLM testing. They contain no
recorded human speech or third-party source media.

These fixture data may be redistributed with this repository under
`LicenseRef-OCRLLM-Repo-Owned-Test-Data`. FFmpeg and libmp3lame were used only
as explicit developer generation tools; their binaries are not included and
are not runtime or ordinary-test dependencies.
